charge_description: having in his possession one fourteen-pound weight which was short by one ounce and two drams, and another fourteen-pound weight which was short by eight drams
raw_record: Summary conviction of Robert Robson of Whitby grocer for having in his possession one fourteen-pound weight which was short by one ounce and two drams, and another fourteen-pound weight which was short by eight drams. Offence committed at Whitby on 20 December 1808. Whitby Strand Petty Sessional division - case heard at Whitby
